    <bpmn:participant id="ORG" name="Organisation" processRef="process1"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="process1" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="laneCSR" name="Customer Service Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>sendOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>waitReply</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>updateDetails1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>archive1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>generateRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>waitResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>updateDetails2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>archive2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gatewayReply</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gatewayDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gatewayResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endCancelled1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endCancelled2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="laneAdmin" name="Administration">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>completeAdmin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Process start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="sendOffer" name="Send Mortgage offer to customer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="waitReply" name="Wait for customer reply"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gatewayReply" name="Customer declines?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="updateDetails1" name="Update case details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="archive1" name="Archive case before cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endCancelled1" name="Case cancelled"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gatewayDocs" name="All prerequisite documents provided?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="completeAdmin" name="Complete case in administration"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endCompleted" name="Case completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="generateRequest" name="Generate request for outstanding documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="waitResponse" name="Wait for customer response (2 weeks)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gatewayResponse" name="Response received?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="updateDetails2" name="Update case details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="archive2" name="Archive case before cancellation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endCancelled2" name="Case cancelled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="sendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="sendOffer" targetRef="waitReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="waitReply" targetRef="gatewayReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="decline" sourceRef="gatewayReply" targetRef="updateDetails1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="updateDetails1" targetRef="archive1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="archive1" targetRef="endCancelled1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="accept" sourceRef="gatewayReply" targetRef="gatewayDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="all docs provided" sourceRef="gatewayDocs" targetRef="completeAdmin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="completeAdmin" targetRef="endCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" name="missing docs" sourceRef="gatewayDocs" targetRef="generateRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="generateRequest" targetRef="waitResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="waitResponse" targetRef="gatewayResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="response received" sourceRef="gatewayResponse" targetRef="completeAdmin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" name="no response" sourceRef="gatewayResponse" targetRef="updateDetails2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="updateDetails2" targetRef="archive2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="archive2" targetRef="endCancelled2"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
